supplemental_zero_allocation_reason: The three core sources expose direct question-to-supporting-memory gold. SGD and Taskmaster remain source-locked reserves for natural-language stress only if the pre-performance eligibility audit proves an objective structural/domain capacity shortfall; they are not used merely to increase apparent diversity.

personamem-v2.subject: persona_id evaluator metadata
personamem-v2.temporal_update: updated plus prev_pref/preference when source-native fields are present

longmemeval-cleaned.memories: each source haystack session deterministically concatenated from its original ordered role/content turns
longmemeval-cleaned.subject: question_id as evaluator-only history identity
longmemeval-cleaned.relation: question_type as source-native task relation class
forbidden: inspect Candidate-v13 output during gold construction

perltqa-en-v2.subject: character name evaluator metadata

mapping.profile: Reference Memory must exactly equal a key in memory[character].profile
mapping.events: each Reference Memory entry must exactly equal a key in memory[character].events
mapping.social_relationship: each Reference Memory entry must exactly equal a key in memory[character].social_relationship
mapping.dialogues: each Reference Memory entry must exactly equal a key in memory[character].dialogues

memory_text.profile: verbatim source profile field value only
memory_text.events: verbatim event content, falling back to verbatim summary only when content is empty

relation.events: verbatim Theme when present, otherwise events
relation.social_relationship: verbatim Relationship when present, otherwise social_relationship

perltqa-en-v2.timestamp: verbatim Creation Time for events when present; otherwise omitted
perltqa-en-v2.base_item_id: character plus section plus immutable QA structural path
perltqa-en-v2.exclusion: Any canonical QA whose character or any Reference Memory entry cannot be exact-mapped is excluded before allocation; no aliases or repairs are allowed.

domain_classifier.method: deterministic case-insensitive token/phrase matching over source-native query, relation and gold-memory text; structured profile-field overrides apply before lexical rules

structured_overrides.personamem_fallback: D1 because every base record is explicitly a user preference record
structured_overrides.perltqa_events_dialogues_fallback: D8 because the source record is a personal event/activity memory
structured_overrides.longmemeval_fallback: D8 because the source record is a personal interaction/activity memory

domain_classifier.unclassified_policy: Exclude unless one of the explicit source-specific fallbacks applies.

structural_family_eligibility.N1: answerable natural query with 5-18 whitespace tokens, terminal question mark, and not selected by N5 or N8 natural flags
structural_family_eligibility.N2: query has >=18 whitespace tokens OR at least two comma/semicolon/parenthetical punctuation boundaries OR a generic discourse marker
structural_family_eligibility.N3: base case is eligible when a deterministic distractor from a different evaluator subject exists; the query itself is not rewritten
structural_family_eligibility.N4: base case is eligible when a deterministic distractor with the same subject but different evaluator relation exists
structural_family_eligibility.N5: query contains a generic pronoun/demonstrative/coreference token while the evaluator subject string is not literally present in the query
structural_family_eligibility.N6: PersonaMem source-native updated state with prev_pref OR LongMemEval question_type in {knowledge-update, temporal-reasoning}
structural_family_eligibility.N7: PersonaMem prev_pref and current preference are both nonempty and normalized unequal
structural_family_eligibility.N8: query or gold memory contains a generic modality/uncertainty term: may, might, maybe, perhaps, possibly, probably, plan, planned, planning, hope, expect, intend, tentative, could, would, should
structural_family_eligibility.N9: a non-gold deterministic distractor exists whose normalized token-overlap score with the query is strictly greater than the best gold-memory overlap score
structural_family_eligibility.N10: any valid base case; all gold evidence is withheld by the preregistered no-evidence transform
structural_family_eligibility.N11: natural query has <=12 whitespace tokens and at least one elliptical signal: lacks terminal question mark, begins with pronoun/demonstrative, contains ellipsis, contains contraction, or begins lowercase
structural_family_eligibility.N12: a deterministic non-gold memory exists with the same evaluator subject and relation as the gold case

memory_composition.default: all gold memories plus deterministic distractors up to 20
memory_composition.N3: ensure at least two evaluator subjects are present
memory_composition.N4: ensure at least one same-subject different-relation distractor
memory_composition.N6: retain source-native stale/current evidence when available
memory_composition.N7: retain source-native previous/current conflicting preference states when available
memory_composition.N9: include the preregistered higher-overlap lexical decoy
memory_composition.N12: include at least one same-subject same-relation non-gold distractor

no_evidence_assignment: N10 is always no-evidence; remaining no-evidence quota is assigned by deterministic SHA256 ordering across non-N10 selected cases, with gold withholding only and no query rewrite.
allocation_algorithm: Deterministic max-flow first satisfies per-stage source and domain marginals using eligible source/domain capacities; selected base cases are then assigned to N1-N12 with a deterministic bipartite max-flow over family eligibility. If exact preregistered marginals cannot be satisfied, no Candidate-v13 execution occurs and reserve-source policy is evaluated.
